units.source_text: 时代改换，万象更新，繁华热闹之事甚多。

en.t: The times changed, everything took on a new appearance, and there were many splendid and lively events.

units.source_text: 源氏权大纳言升任了内大臣。

en.t: Genji, the Provisional Major Counselor, was promoted to Minister of the Center.

units.source_text: 这是因为左右大臣人数规定，目前没有空位，所以用内大臣的名称，作为额外的大臣。

en.t: This was because the number of ministers of the left and right was fixed and there was no vacancy, so the title Minister of the Center was used for an additional minister.

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣应当兼任摄政，但他说：“此乃繁重之职，我实不能胜任。”

en.t: Genji, now Minister of the Center, was expected to serve concurrently as regent, but he said, This is a burdensome office, and I truly cannot fulfill it.

units.source_text: 要把摄政之职让给早已告退的左大臣，即他的岳父。

en.t: He wished to yield the office of regent to the Minister of the Left, his father-in-law, who had long since retired.

units.source_text: 左大臣不肯接受，他说：“我本因病告退，况今年老力衰，未能受此重任。”

en.t: The Minister of the Left refused to accept it, saying, I retired because of illness, and now that I am old and weakened, I cannot take on such a heavy responsibility.

units.source_text: 然而朝中百官和世间臣民都认为外国亦有此例：

en.t: However, all the officials at court and the people of the realm believed that there were precedents for this even in foreign countries:

units.source_text: 每当时势变易，世乱未定之时，即使是遁迹深山、不问政治之人，一旦天下太平，亦必不耻白发高龄，毅然出山从政。

en.t: Whenever the times change and the world remains unsettled, even people who have hidden deep in the mountains and kept away from politics will, once peace returns, feel no shame in their white hair and advanced age, but resolutely come down from the mountains to enter public service.

units.source_text: 此等人正是可尊敬的圣贤。

en.t: Such people are precisely the sages worthy of respect.

units.source_text: 左大臣昔曾因病告退，但今时移势迁，恢复旧职，有何不可？

en.t: The Minister of the Left once retired because of illness, but now that the times and circumstances have changed, what objection could there be to his resuming his former post?

units.source_text: 且在日本，亦有此例。

en.t: Moreover, there were precedents for this in Japan as well.

units.source_text: 左大臣不便坚辞，便当了太政大臣，此时高龄六十三岁。

en.t: The Minister of the Left could no longer firmly refuse, and so he became Chancellor, at the venerable age of sixty-three.

units.source_text: 他昔年为了时局不利而去官辞职，笼闭在家，今日又恢复了荣华富贵。

en.t: In former years, because the political situation was unfavorable, he had left office, resigned his post, and shut himself away at home; now he once again regained glory, rank, and wealth.

units.source_text: 他家诸公子以前沉沦宦海，今日也都升官晋爵了。

en.t: The young noblemen of his household, who had previously languished in official life, were now all promoted in office and rank.

units.source_text: 特别是宰相中将升任了权中纳言。

en.t: In particular, the Consultant Captain was promoted to Provisional Middle Counselor.

units.source_text: 他的正夫人——已故右大臣家的四女公子——所生的女儿，年方十二，准备送她入宫当新帝的女御，故而倍加珍爱。

en.t: The daughter born to his principal wife, the fourth princess of the late Minister of the Right's family, was just twelve years old, and because they planned to send her to court as a consort of the new emperor, she was cherished all the more.

units.source_text: 他的儿子，即以前在二条院唱催马乐《高砂》的红梅，也已行过冠礼。

en.t: His son, Kobai, who had once sung the saibara song Takasago at the Nijo residence, had also already undergone his coming-of-age ceremony.

units.source_text: 真可谓万事如意称心了。

en.t: It could truly be said that everything had turned out exactly as he wished.

units.source_text: 此外他的许多如夫人接连地生育，子女成群，家庭热闹非常。

en.t: In addition, his many secondary wives kept bearing children one after another, so sons and daughters filled the household and the family was exceedingly lively.

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣看了不胜羡慕。

en.t: When Genji, the Minister of the Center, saw this, he could not help feeling deeply envious.
